name: JournalEntry
description: A journal entry — a direct posting of debits and credits to general ledger accounts.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this JournalEntry object, assigned by QuickBooks. Required for get, update, and delete.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update operations to ensure optimistic concurrency control.

fields.name: Line
fields.description: The individual debit and credit lines of the journal entry. At least two lines are required, and total debits must equal total credits.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: The line item identifier. Omitted on create; supplied on update to identify an existing line.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.description: Free-form text description of the line, up to 4000 characters.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: The amount of the line (debit or credit), as determined by the line's PostingType.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating which line detail object is populated. For JournalEntry lines this is always JournalEntryLineDetail.

attributes.name: JournalEntryLineDetail
attributes.description: Posting detail for the line. Required because every JournalEntry line is a posting line.

attributes.name: PostingType
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit or a credit posting to the referenced account.

attributes.name: AccountRef
attributes.description: Reference to the general ledger account being debited or credited.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Account.

attributes.name: Entity
attributes.description: The customer, vendor, or employee associated with this line, used for accounts that track a name (e.g. Accounts Receivable or Accounts Payable).

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: The type of entity referenced by EntityRef.

attributes.name: EntityRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Customer, Vendor, or Employee.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced entity.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced entity.

attributes.name: ClassRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Class associated with this line. Available when class tracking is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Class.

attributes.name: DepartmentRef
attributes.description: Reference to the Department (location) associated with this line. Available when location tracking is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced Department.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced Department.

attributes.name: TaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxCode for this line. Applicable in non-US locales with automated sales tax.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: TaxApplicableOn
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax applied on this line is sales tax or purchase tax. Used in non-US locales.

attributes.name: TaxAmount
attributes.description: The tax amount associated with this line, in non-US locales.

attributes.name: BillableStatus
attributes.description: The billable status of the line when associated with a customer Entity.

attributes.name: JournalCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the JournalCode for this line. Required for France locale companies.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced JournalCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced JournalCode.

fields.name: Adjustment
fields.description: Indicates whether this journal entry is an adjusting entry (true) used by accountants to adjust the books. Defaults to false.

fields.name: TxnDate
fields.description: The date of the journal entry transaction. If not supplied, defaults to the current date.

fields.name: DocNumber
fields.description: Reference number for the transaction. If not supplied, QuickBooks may auto-assign one depending on company settings. Max 21 characters.

fields.name: PrivateNote
fields.description: A private memo for the journal entry that is not visible to external parties. Up to 4000 characters.

fields.name: TxnTaxDetail
fields.description: Transaction-level tax details summarizing the sales/purchase tax for the entire journal entry. Used in non-US locales.

attributes.name: TxnTaxCodeRef
attributes.description: Reference to the transaction-level TaxCode.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxCode.

attributes.name: TotalTax
attributes.description: Total tax calculated for the transaction, excluding any tax marked as not affecting the line amount.

attributes.name: TaxLine
attributes.description: Per-component tax detail lines for the transaction.

attributes.name: Amount
attributes.description: Tax amount for this tax line component.

attributes.name: DetailType
attributes.description: Discriminator for the tax line; always TaxLineDetail.

attributes.name: TaxLineDetail
attributes.description: Detail of the tax line component.

attributes.name: TaxRateRef
attributes.description: Reference to the TaxRate applied for this component.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The Id of the referenced TaxRate.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Display name of the referenced TaxRate.

attributes.name: PercentBased
attributes.description: True if the tax is percentage-based rather than a fixed amount.

attributes.name: TaxPercent
attributes.description: The tax rate percentage applied, when PercentBased is true.

attributes.name: NetAmountTaxable
attributes.description: The net amount on which the tax was calculated.

fields.name: CurrencyRef
fields.description: Reference to the currency of all amounts in this transaction. Used when multicurrency is enabled.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The full name of the currency.

fields.name: ExchangeRate
fields.description: The exchange rate between the transaction currency and the home currency, applicable when multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: GlobalTaxCalculation
fields.description: Indicates how tax is applied to transaction amounts. Applicable to companies in non-US locales that support automated sales tax.

fields.name: TotalAmt
fields.description: The total amount of the transaction (sum of the debit lines) in the transaction currency, computed by QuickBooks.

fields.name: HomeTotalAmt
fields.description: The total amount of the transaction in the home currency, computed by QuickBooks when multicurrency is enabled.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: System-maintained descriptive metadata about the object.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the object was created (read-only).

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the object was last modified (read-only).

fields.name: domain
fields.description: System-defined origin of the object; always 'QBO'.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Indicates whether the response represents a sparse (partial) object. Used in sparse update workflows.
